verses.en: And after these things I saw another angel come down from heaven, having great power; and the earth was lightened with his glory.
verses.sm: ona ou i iloa atu lea o le agelu o loo alu ifo i le lagi, ua ia te ia le pwe sili; ua malamalama foi le lalolagi i lona pupula.

verses.en: And he cried mightily with a strong voice, saying, Babylon the great is fallen, is fallen, and is become the habitation of devils, and the hold of every foul spirit, and a cage of every unclean and hateful bird.
verses.sm: Ua matua alaga foi O ia ma le leo tele, ua faapea ane, “Ua pau, ua pati Papelonia le aai tele! Ua avea foi o ia ma mea e nofo ai temoni, ma mea e puipui ai agaga leaga uma, o le mea foi e puipui ai manu felelei uma e leaga ma le inosia;

verses.en: For all nations have drunk of the wine of the wrath of her fornication, and the kings of the earth have committed fornication with her, and the merchants of the earth are waxed rich through the abundance of her delicacies.
verses.sm: aua ua feinu nuu uma ile uaina o le toasa i lana faitaaga, ua faitaaga foi ma ia tupu o le lalolagi, o le faulaiga o ana mea faafiafia ua tamaoaiga ai e ua faatau oa o i le lalolagi.”

verses.en: And I heard another voice from heaven, saying, Come out of her, my people, that ye be not partakers of her sins, and that ye receive not of her plagues.
verses.sm: Ua ou faalogo foi i le tasi leo mai le lagi, ua faapea mai, “Lo'u nuu e, ía outou O ese ia te ia, ina neʻi faatasia outou i ana agasala, ina ne“ tofusia foi outou i ona mala;

verses.en: For her sins have reached unto heaven, and God hath remembered her iniquities.
verses.sm: aua ua paí atu ana agasala i le lagi, ua manatua foi e le Atua ana amioleaga.

verses.en: Reward her even as she rewarded you, and double unto her double according to her works: in the cup which she hath filled fill to her double.
verses.sm: Ia outou taui atu ia te ia ia pei ona taui mai e ia ia te outou, ia outou taui faalua ia te ia e tusa ma ana galuega; o le ipu foi na liligi mai ai e ia, ia outou liligi faaluaina atu ai la te ia.

verses.en: How much she hath glorified herself, and lived deliciously, so much torment and sorrow give her: for she saith in her heart, I sit a queen, and am no widow, and shall see no sorrow.
verses.sm: E pei ona mitamita o ia ia te ia, mona ua faafiafia o ia ia te ia, ia faapea ona outou tuuina atu ia te ia o le puapuaga ma le faanoanoa. Aua ua faapea ifo ia i lona loto, Ou te nofo nei o le tupu fafine, ou te le se fafine ua oti lana tane, ou te le iloa lava se faanoanoa;

verses.en: Therefore shall her plagues come in one day, death, and mourning, and famine; and she shall be utterly burned with fire: for strong is the Lord God who judgeth her.
verses.sm: o le mea lea e oo mai ai i le aso e tasi ona mala, o le faamai, ma le faanoanoa, ma le oge; e susunuina foi o ia i le afi; aua e mamana lava le Alii le Atua o lé faamasino ia te ia.”

verses.en: And the kings of the earth, who have committed fornication and lived deliciously with her, shall bewail her, and lament for her, when they shall see the smoke of her burning,
verses.sm: O tupu foi o le lalolagi e na faitaaga ma faafiafia i latou faatasi ma ia, latou te taufaitagi ia te ia ma taufaitagitu‘i ona o ia, pe a latou iloa atu le asu o lona susunuina;

verses.en: Standing afar off for the fear of her torment, saying, Alas, alas, that great city Babylon, that mighty city! for in one hour is thy judgment come.
verses.sm: Io e tutu mamao i latou ona o le fefe i lona puapuaga, e faapea atu, “Aue! aue! Papelonia e, le aai tele ma le aai malosi! Aua o le itu aso e tasi ua oo mai ai lau sala.”

verses.en: And the merchants of the earth shall weep and mourn over her; for no man buyeth their merchandise any more:
verses.sm: O faatauoa foi i le lalolagi e taufaitagi i latou ma faanoanoa ona O ia; aua e le toe faatau e se tasi a latou oloa;

verses.en: The merchandise of gold, and silver, and precious stones, and of pearls, and fine linen, and purple, and silk, and scarlet, and all thyine wood, and all manner vessels of ivory, and all manner vessels of most precious wood, and of brass, and iron, and marble,
verses.sm: O le oloa auro, ma ario, ma maa tiua, ma penina, ma ie vavae, ma ie pauli, ma le silika, ma ie ie tiu, ma laau manogi uma, ma ipu nifo elefane uma, ma ipu laau matua taua uma, ma le “apa memea, ma le uamea, ma le maamora,

verses.en: And cinnamon, and odours, and ointments, and frankincense, and wine, and oil, and fine flour, and wheat, and beasts, and sheep, and horses, and chariots, and slaves, and souls of men.
verses.sm: ma kinamomi, ma mea manogi, ma le suāuu manogi, ma le pulu lipano, ma le uaina, ma le uu olive, ma le falaoa lelei, ma le saito, ma manu, ma mamoe, ma solofanua, ma nofoa faataavalevale, o pologa foi, atoa ma agaga otagata.

verses.en: And the fruits that thy soul lusted after are departed from thee, and all things which were dainty and goodly are departed from thee, and thou shalt find them no more at all.
verses.sm: “Ua tea foi ma oe o fua na e tu‘inanau i ai, ua teía foi ma oe mea lalelei uma ma mea pupula, e te le toe maua lava ia mea!”

verses.en: The merchants of these things, which were made rich by her, shall stand afar off for the fear of her torment, weeping and wailing,
verses.sm: O e faatau ia mea, o e tamaoaiga ona o ia, latou te tuti mamao ma le fefe i lona puapuaga, o loo taufaitagi ma faanoanoa,

verses.en: And saying, Alas, alas, that great city, that was clothed in fine linen, and purple, and scarlet, and decked with gold, and precious stones, and pearls!
verses.sm: o loo faapea atu, “Aue! ane! le aai tele, na ofu i le ie vavae ma le páuli, ma le mumu, na teteu foi i auro, ma maa tana ma penina!

verses.en: For in one hour so great riches is come to nought. And every shipmaster, and all the company in ships, and sailors, and as many as trade by sea, stood afar off,
verses.sm: aua o le itu aso e tasi ua faaumatia ai le oloa ua sili ona tele.” O tautai uma, atoa ma tagata uma o i vaa, ma auvaa, atoa uma ma e feoai i le vasa, ua tutii mamao i latou,

verses.en: And cried when they saw the smoke of her burning, saying, What city is like unto this great city!
verses.sm: ma latou alalaga ina o iloa mai le asu o lona susunuina ua faapea, “O fea se aai e tusa ma lenei aai tele?”

verses.en: And they cast dust on their heads, and cried, weeping and wailing, saying, Alas, alas, that great city, wherein were made rich all that had ships in the sea by reason of her costliness! for in one hour is she made desolate.
verses.sm: Ua latou lafo ae foi le eleele i o latou ulu, ua alalaga, ma taufaitagi, ma faanoanoa, ua faapea atu, “Aue! aue! le aai tele, na tamaoaiga ai i latou uma Ua viia le Atua aua ua ia faamasino o e o i ai vaa i le vasa, ona i le fafine talitane tele o ana mea táua; Ua mavae nei mea, ona ou auā o le itu aso e tasi ua faalogo lea e peiseai o le leo faatafunaina ai o ia. tele o le motu o tagata e toatele o i

verses.en: Rejoice over her, thou heaven, and ye holy apostles and prophets; for God hath avenged you on her.
verses.sm: Ia e olioli ona o ia, le lagi e, le lagi, ua faapea atu, atoa ma outou tagata paia, ma aposetolo ma perofeta; aua ua faasalaina o ia e le Atua ona o le faasalaina o outou e ia.”

verses.en: And a mighty angel took up a stone like a great millstone, and cast it into the sea, saying, Thus with violence shall that great city Babylon be thrown down, and shall be found no more at all.
verses.sm: Ua siitia foi e le tasi agelu malosi o le maa e pei o se maaolo tele, ma lafo i le sami, ua faapea atu, “E faapea ona lafotuina o Papelonia le aai tele, e le toe iloa lava.

verses.en: And the voice of harpers, and musicians, and of pipers, and trumpeters, shall be heard no more at all in thee; and no craftsman, of whatsoever craft he be, shall be found any more in thee; and the sound of a millstone shall be heard no more at all in thee;
verses.sm: E le toe lagona foi ia te oe le leo o e ta kitara, ma ē lagi siva,

verses.en: And the light of a candle shall shine no more at all in thee; and the voice of the bridegroom and of the bride shall be heard no more at all in thee: for thy merchants were the great men of the earth; for by thy sorceries were all nations deceived.
verses.sm: ma E ili fagufagu, “Aleluia! Ua i le Alii lo tatou Atua le faaolataga,

verses.en: And in her was found the blood of prophets, and of saints, and of all that were slain upon the earth.
verses.sm: ma le viiga ma le faaneeneega, ma le mana;
